v.s: Clint fires 5 bullets in quick succession in the target direction, each dealing 250( +85% Total Physical Attack) (Physical Damage) to the enemy hit.\nThe bullets will spread evenly across enemies in a fan-shaped area. Enemies hit by multiple bullets will take less damage after the first bullet.
This skill has a powerful effect, but is relatively situational and has a small range. Use it to limit enemy movement and trigger Clint's passive.

Clint shoots a trap net in the target direction, slightly jumping back while dealing 140( +30% Total Physical Attack)( +150% Total Magic Power) (Physical Damage) to the first enemy hit and immobilizing them for 1.2s.\nSuccessfully hitting an enemy reduces the cooldown of this skill by 40%.
Clint can fire this backwards when being chased, and can also use it to jump through walls. Has a wide range of applications.

Clint launches a grenade in the target direction that explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing 280( +100% Total Physical Attack) (Physical Damage) and slowing them by 25% for 1.2s.\nClint gains a grenade charge every 12s (up to 5).
High single-target damage and can be used frequently. Make sure you're stocked up on grenades before entering a team fight!

After each skill cast, Clint's next Basic Attack within 4s penetrates a line of enemies, dealing 50( +120% Total Physical Attack) (Physical Damage). This damage can trigger attack effects, and the part affected by Physical Attack can Crit.
This is a very strong passive, and helps with sustainability in the laning phase, as well as reaching squishier back-row heroes.
Unique Passive - Divine Justice: After casting a skill, the next Basic Attack within 3s deals 60% Physical Attack as extra True Damage (1.5s cooldown).
Unique Passive - Doom: Critical strikes grant 5% extra Physical Attack for 2s.
Unique Passive - Supreme Warrior: After casting an Ultimate, increase Movement Speed by 15% for 7.5s. This effect has a 15s cooldown.
Unique Passive - Armor Buster: When attacking an enemy, gains 0.125% extra Physical Penetration for each point of the enemy's Physical Defense, capped at 40%.

Unique Passive - Lifeline: When taking damage that reduces HP below 30%, gain a 420-910 shield (increases with level) and 50% Movement Speed that rapidly decays over 3s. This effect has a 60s cooldown.
